name: Glasgow Winter 2023

venue.name: University Centre Building, University of Strathclyde

information:
If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in the [**FAQ**](#22988-faq) and the [**Important Information**](#22989-important-information) tabs before registering. All competitors should be familiar with the information in these tabs.

**Please fill in the Guests number in your registration as accurately as possible.** We have a limit on the number of people allowed in the venue. See the [**Guests**](#23843-guests-important) tab for details.

The venue on **Friday** will be in room **GH554** in the university. This is on Floor 5 of the Graham Hills building and is well signposted.
